updates.text: Butler's press transition was late once against Hurns. Oden corrected it, and the August 1 rep was on time. A single retained correction leaves a later test open.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: Thirteen defensive snaps after Poyer's and Talib's removals and 20 on the kicking game with no tackle or target recorded against him; the play-by-play records no defender on the completions in Indianapolis's last two drives, so his coverage is the film's. A head/neck injury, short, was logged at the end of Indianapolis's last touchdown drive at 1:01 of the fourth quarter; he was removed, Chris Prosinski taking his place by the chart's order for the two kneel-downs with no pause recorded, and he is on an independent medical hold: projected return October 2, reassessment September 24 ([medical record](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/incidents/malcolm_butler_2014-09-21.md)). On the projection he misses the San Diego game. No football finding attaches to the hold.
updates.source: Source: [Week 3 game record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_03/output.md) and its public receipt. This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: His independent medical hold was reassessed Wednesday, September 24, with no change, projected return October 2; no football work in the San Diego week; out on the Friday report and inactive by medical instruction for Week 4, listed last among the defensive backs while out. The staff's no-transaction recommendation went to Caldwell; no transaction was made. No football finding attaches to the hold.
updates.source: Source: [Week 4 record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_04/output.md) and the [medical history](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/medical_history.md#september-22-to-27-kelce-talib-and-adams-cleared-butler-and-poyer-reassessed). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: His independent medical hold was released Thursday, October 2, its projected date, by the independent process; he took no part in the Monday walkthrough or the Wednesday practice and then took approved preparation work in full on Thursday and Friday and in the Saturday walkthrough. Stone's packet had already made him inactive for Pittsburgh whether or not the release came, rather than install a new dime or kicking-game job late in the week, and that decision stands; no designation on the Friday report. No football finding attaches to the hold or the decision.
